content.short: The first perpetual lottery on Cardano.
content.description: This first generation is a simple per epoch lottery. 3 winners are picked at random at the close of the epoch. Its ran successfully now for about 10 epochs. Everything is generated real time, and payouts use entropy derived from the blockchain. Future growth plans for large payout lottery structure.
